windows.label: Stream output rollout, outside the challenge
windows.details: The challenge output is SBE written to a file. Afterwards we added an optional WebSocket stream output for the same SBE records; only the output step changed. Before this window: the challenge's file output. After it: stream output, which may differ slightly. Inside it the collector restarted four times (12:40, 12:55, 13:35 and 14:08 UTC) while stream mode was enabled and two measurement errors were fixed, so ignore this period.
